report.scope: Identical production frontend, common loopback HTTP/SSE bridge, identical existing Node worker backend and deterministic native-intake fixtures. Rust business-logic rewrite is not measured.

measurement.frameLatency: DOM correctness at a subsequent RAF opportunity; not native compositor or photon latency.
measurement.clock: Constant offset aligns market candle boundaries; real timers, performance.now and native OS counters are not slowed or accelerated.

energy.reason: Total app/device energy and GPU energy cannot be attributed. Privileged powermetrics is unavailable; per-task CPU energy is measured separately with the supported kernel nanojoule counter.

interpretation.cpu: Percent of one core, weighted by sampled interval duration. CPU seconds and joules cover the whole sampling window only when all intervals are complete.
interpretation.energy: CPU-only per-process energy; not total application, device, GPU, display, or shared-system energy.
interpretation.footprint: Arithmetic mean and peak of complete 1 Hz physical-footprint snapshots; the peak is sampled, not continuous.
interpretation.coverage: Coverage is of recorded intervals and snapshots, not a guarantee that short-lived processes or all WebKit work were attributed.
interpretation.interaction: Acknowledged latency uses only individually unique, correct committed input records; p50/p95 use nearest rank. Superseded inputs are separate.
interpretation.realtime: Delivery counts refer to the focused contract/timeframe; source timing includes clock calibration uncertainty. RAF is an opportunity and DOM commit, not physical presentation.
interpretation.paired: Per-pair relative percent is (Tauri - Electron) / Electron × 100, only for matching valid formal workloads and complete metric coverage; no inference of significance.

validation.dualRuntimeSmoke: passed all four scenarios with complete operation recording
validation.finalElectronCleanupSmoke: passed all four scenarios, runtime and backend exit code 0
validation.tauriInterruption: passed exit code 130, no forced termination, atomic report preserved, no owned bundle processes remaining
validation.reviewHardening: Reject unequal completed work; unique bundle ownership independent of readiness; ordered interruption cleanup and atomic report writes. No resource-counter arithmetic, frontend, runtime binary, replay cadence or formal numerical result changes.
